_doc: Baked offline MetaHuman bodies (scripts/ue/mh_bake.py) in the production project, docs/12 'MetaHuman route'. height_cm = body-mesh bounds z / 0.83 (the head is the separate face mesh; ratio measured 2026-09-25). walk_speed_mps is the in-place walk loop's stance-foot ground speed at rate 1.0 (1.83 m/s, measured by AnimPose FK over the 4 s loop, 8 steps) normalised to a 1.75 m person from a 1.60 m reference skeleton. xmax_cm = body bounds half-width along X (A-pose arm span, for the painted-clothing sleeve mask). The baked ChaosCloth outfit (only MHB02 has one) is off unless SURVSIM_MH_GARMENT=1: painted clothing is used for everyone.
